set — your display preferences, all in one grammar

  .set                  list them all, marking the house defaults
  .set <topic>          show one, and how to change it
  .set <topic> <value>  set it
  .set <topic> default  back to the house default
  .set default          all eight back to the house default

dim        on|off      fade system lines so speech stands out (web: .theme)
time       on|off      prefix lines with HH:MM, for you alone
helpstyle  long|short  which .help you get
enter_msg  text        walking into a room: "Name <text>"
exit_msg   text        walking out of a room; yours names no destination
afk_msg    text        what a bare .afk says: "Name is AFK: <text>"
login_msg  phrase      your login line, shown as [Name <phrase>]
logout_msg phrase      your logout line, shown as [Name <phrase>]

Every default here is the HOUSE default. While you are on it you follow
the house: if the owner rewords it, your next line changes with it,
no relogging. Choose your own and it is yours until you say 'default'.

name is the exception: .set name <NewCapitalization> restyles your own
name's capitalization. That is an identity restyle, not a display
preference, so it has no 'default' and '.set default' leaves it alone —
as it leaves .remember alone, for the same reason.
